磁带录音机：一种用于录音和播放磁带的设备。

sentences.c: He was wired up to a police tape recorder.
sentences.cn: 他被连接到了警方的录音机上。

sentences.c: The guards permitted me to bring my camera and tape recorder.
sentences.cn: 守卫允许我带上相机和录音机。

sentences.c: Who invented the tape recorder?
sentences.cn: 录音机是谁发明的？

trans.cn: 介绍内容的录像

sentences.c: The future network will increase the amount of information video.
sentences.cn: 未来的网络视频的信息量会增多。

sentences.c: We aimed to examine the effects of adding an information video to our usual preprocedural information.
sentences.cn: 我们研究的目的是检测在结肠镜检查前常规指导中增加内镜录像资料指导的影响。

sentences.c: Each contains further information on the video it represents, including the category, title, description, publication date, author, and duration.
sentences.cn: 每个包含它所表示的视频的更多信息，包括类别、标题、描述、发布日期、作者和持续时间。

trans.cn: 录像
视频录制：通过摄影电视显像管拍摄的电视制作的动态影片，也可以指视频磁带录制。

sentences.c: We've been advising shop owners along there about what kind of video recording equipment they can have put in—we'll then be able to get evidence of any criminal activity on film.
sentences.cn: 我们一直在向那里的店主们建议，他们应该安装什么样的录像设备——这样我们就能在录像中找到任何犯罪活动的证据。

sentences.c: We have viewed the video recording of the incident.
sentences.cn: 我们已观看了该事件的录像。

sentences.c: Section 3 Sound Recording and Video Recording.
sentences.cn: 第四章出版、表演、录音录像、播放第三节录音录像。

trans.cn: 录像编辑
máy ghi âm
trans.cn_source: 录音机

trans.cn: 磁带录音机：一种能够在磁带上录音的录音机。

sentences.c: I'd like to buy a cassette recorder.
sentences.cn: 我想买一台盒式磁带录音机。

sentences.c: I think I've broken your cassette recorder.
sentences.cn: 我想我弄坏了你的盒式磁带录音机。

sentences.c: Could you show me how to use this cassette recorder?
sentences.cn: 你能向我示范怎样使用这台卡式录音机吗？

trans.cn: 录像声音

sentences.c: Futhermore, you can set the start and end time of the video sound that you want to extract .
sentences.cn: 此外，您可以设定开始和结束时间的视频声音，你要提取的。

sentences.c: A sound card gives a computer the capability to record and play sound files as well as video sound tracks.
sentences.cn: 声卡为计算机提供了录制与放映声音文件的功能，作用类似于录音带。

sentences.c: Using objects such as mirrors or video recordings as they practice can show speakers what they look and sound like to the audience.
sentences.cn: 在练习时，使用镜子或录像等物品，可以展示演讲者在面对观众时他们的样子和声音。

trans.cn: 记笔记
做笔记：记录下所听到或观察到的内容，以备将来参考。

sentences.c: Even if you highlight important points or take notes in a class, you probably do not fully understand what you learned.
sentences.cn: 即使你在课堂上用彩色笔标出中重点或记笔记，你都不一定能完全理解你学到的东西。

sentences.c: Did you take notes in the class?
sentences.cn: 你在课堂上做了笔记吗？

sentences.c: Even worse, he forgot to take notes during the meeting.
sentences.cn: 更糟糕的是，他在会议中忘记做笔记了。

trans.cn: 辍学率
退学率：指在一定时间内，学生中辍学的比例。

sentences.c: Articles in magazines and newspapers and special reports on radio and television reflect the concern of many Americans about the increasing drop-out rate in our junior and senior high schools.
sentences.cn: 杂志和报纸上的文章、电台和电视台的特别报道都反映了许多美国人对初高中不断上升的辍学率的关注。

sentences.c: The drop-out rate is highest in the poorest urban area.
sentences.cn: 最贫困城区的辍学率最高。

sentences.c: We should decrease the drop-out rate at school by promoting compulsory education.
sentences.cn: 我们要通过推行义务教育来不断降低失学率。

trans.cn: 速度，速率
速度变化率
tỷ lệ
trans.cn_source: 速率

sentences.c: And then rate of speed equals distance over time.
sentences.cn: 通过路程和时间计算出我们的速度。

sentences.c: You can perform a task on a cluster at a much faster rate of speed.
sentences.cn: 可以在集群上以更快的速度执行一项任务。

sentences.c: We analysed the amount of calculating work and the rate of speed increase.
sentences.cn: 分析了每步迭代所需的计算工作量和速度增长倍数。

trans.cn: 小组讨论
小组讨论：涉及一些通过某种共同活动、兴趣或特质相互联系的人之间的讨论。

sentences.c: Most people have individual study more than group discussion.
sentences.cn: 大多数人有个人研习多于集体讨论。

sentences.c: Slashdot focuses instead on group discussion and news-worthiness of links.
sentences.cn: 而Slashdot却将目光集中在了组讨论和链接的新闻价值上。

sentences.c: People make their minds up to varying degrees before they have a group discussion.
sentences.cn: 人们在开始群体讨论前对问题已经有了不同程度的决断。

trans.cn: 学校团队
学校团体：由学校组织的一群学生，通常为了参加某项活动或比赛而组成。

sentences.c: I'm the only girl in my school group.
sentences.cn: 在学校，我是我们小集团中唯一的女孩。

sentences.c: She's in my tutor group at school.
sentences.cn: 她在学校里是指导我的那个小组的成员。

sentences.c: At school he played bass in a pop group called The Urge.
sentences.cn: 上学的时候他在一个叫“冲动”的流行乐队中担任低音电吉他手。

trans.cn: 讨论小组

sentences.c: Ask around your tutorial group: What is learning?
sentences.cn: 请问你的同组同学：什么是学习？

sentences.c: You'll have to give a small talk to your tutorial group...
sentences.cn: 你得对辅导老师组做一个演讲。

sentences.c: Although the personal address book template does more than simply store contact and contact group information, this tutorial focuses on these two aspects of the application template in this tutorial.
sentences.cn: 尽管个人地址簿模板不只是存储联系人和联系人组信息，但是本教程只关注该应用程序模板的这两个方面。

trans.cn: 在小组中
团队合作：与他人一起工作，共同完成任务或项目。

sentences.c: You like to work in a group or alone?
sentences.cn: 你喜欢群体工作或个人工作？

sentences.c: If they want to work in a group setting, they can join an organization.
sentences.cn: 如果他们想在团队里工作，他们可以加入组织。

sentences.c: Work in a group. Introduce yourself to your friends, then learn more about them. You may ask questions as follows.
sentences.cn: 分小组活动，对你的朋友们作自我介绍，然后去试着了解他们，你可以提以下问题。

trans.cn: 团队会议
团队会议：由一组人员参与的会议，旨在讨论和解决共同的问题、制定计划或进行决策。

sentences.c: At the Advisory Group meeting, other progress on the Global Action Plan was discussed.
sentences.cn: 在咨询小组会议上，还讨论了全球行动计划取得的其它进展。

sentences.c: Q: How does China comment on the international contact group meeting on Libya held in Doha yesterday?
sentences.cn: 问：中方如何评价昨天在多哈举行的利比亚联络小组会议？

sentences.c: The meeting agreed to hold the next working group meeting in Indonesia in the second half of next March.
sentences.cn: 会议决定于明年3月中下旬在印尼召开下一次工作组会议。

trans.cn: 招生办公室
招生办公室：负责学校或机构的招生工作的办公室，处理申请、录取和入学事务。

sentences.c: "It happened downstairs in the admission office, " Leopold says.
sentences.cn: “故事发生在招生办公室的楼下，”利奥波德说。

sentences.c: You can go through the discharge formalities at the Admission Office.
sentences.cn: 你可以到住院处办理出院手续了。

sentences.c: Please get your enrollment notice, collecting cards, uniforms and etc from the admission office.
sentences.cn: 在招生办公室领取入校通知单，接送卡和校服等。

trans.cn: Trụ sở chính
trans.cn_source: 总部

trans.cn: 总部：一个公司或组织的主要行政中心。

sentences.c: I don't know what head office will think about this proposal.
sentences.cn: 我不知道总公司对此提案会有何想法。

sentences.c: Travel arrangements are subject to confirmation by the head office.
sentences.cn: 旅行安排需经总公司确准。

sentences.c: Bonus notices were issued each year from head office to local agents.
sentences.cn: 红利通告每年由总公司发给各地方代理商。

trans.cn: 就业指导办公室
职业指导员：一名在学校、大学或其他教育机构中为学生提供职业规划和就业建议的专业人士。

sentences.c: Officer Come in, please take a seat. I'm the careers officer. You're Cathy, aren't you?
sentences.cn: 请进，请坐。我是职业咨询师。你是凯西，是吗？

trans.cn: 父母的教育
父母教育：父母对子女进行的教育和指导，包括道德、价值观、行为规范等方面的教育。
父母指导
家长指导：指父母或监护人对孩子的行为、言语和观念进行引导和教育的过程。

sentences.c: Nowadays many TV programs need parental guidance.
sentences.cn: 现在许多电视节目需要家长知道观看。

sentences.c: Someone needs to tell the parents that good intentions alone may not constitute parental guidance.
sentences.cn: 有人需要告诉家长：祖训或许并不只是由美好的目的构成的。

sentences.c: PG-13 — Special parental guidance strongly suggested for children under 13. Some material may be inappropriate for young children.
sentences.cn: 父母指导，强烈建议为13岁以下的儿童。可能不适合年幼的孩子。

trans.cn: giờ
trans.cn_source: 学时

trans.cn: 教学时间：指教师在课堂上进行教学的时间，通常以小时为单位计算。

sentences.c: Working from Monday to Friday, 18 teaching hours per week, 5000 RMB/month.
sentences.cn: 每周一至周五工作，双休，每周完成18个课时，月薪5000元人民币。

sentences.c: What is your weekly teaching hours? How much time do you spend on lesson preparation?
sentences.cn: 你每星期有多少小时的教学任务？你每星期要花多少时间进行备课活动？

sentences.c: There are many problems arisen in teaching hours, textbook system and methodology of psychology teaching in teachers colleges.
sentences.cn: 高师心理学教学中在教学时数、教材体系、教学方法与手段等方面还存在许多问题。

trans.cn: 接待处
接待中心：一个为游客或客户提供信息、服务和设施的地方。

sentences.c: The museum is building a new reception centre for visitors.
sentences.cn: 博物馆正在修建新的来宾接待室。

sentences.c: This region is in front of the Reception Centre, with a land area of 600 square meters.
sentences.cn: 位于接待中心前，占地600平米，是主题公园另一大亮点。

sentences.c: This houses a visitor reception centre with plate glass windows on one side overlooking the park and on the other side looking out onto the vines, both with a ground level view.
sentences.cn: 参观者接待中心一面安装着平板玻璃窗，可远眺庄园，从另一面向外看是葡萄园，两面视野都与地平面齐平。

trans.cn: 接待处
接待台：公共和公司建筑物中接待员所在的地方，通常位于建筑物的前门内部。

sentences.c: All visitors must report to the reception desk on arrival.
sentences.cn: 所有参观者到达后务必在接待处报到。

sentences.c: The reception desk is not at street level, which is a little disconcerting.
sentences.cn: 该接待台不在临街那一层，这有点令人困惑。

sentences.c: She wormed her way through the crowd to the reception desk.
sentences.cn: 她在人群中左拐右绕走到服务台。

trans.cn: 接待处
接待区：公共建筑（如酒店或剧院）内部和靠近入口的大型开放区域，即大厅。

sentences.c: There's a closed-circuit television camera in the reception area.
sentences.cn: 接待处有一台闭路电视摄像机。

sentences.c: This is the tennis club reception area.
sentences.cn: 这是网球俱乐部的接待区。

sentences.c: We left the reception area.
sentences.cn: 我们离开接待区。

trans.cn: 不同的水平
不同的层次或水平：指在某个领域或方面存在着不同的程度、等级或阶段。

sentences.c: Different levels of formality are appropriate in different situations.
sentences.cn: 不同程度的注重礼节适用于不同场合。

sentences.c: Schools in our city provide a variety of optional classes to cater to students of different levels.
sentences.cn: 我们市里的学校提供各式各样的选修课，以满足不同水平的学生。

sentences.c: What's interesting is that birds have different levels of performance of these distraction displays.
sentences.cn: 有趣的是，鸟类在干扰注意力方面有不同程度的表现。

trans.cn: 海平面
海平面：指海洋表面的水平面，特别是指在平均高潮和低潮之间的平均位置上的海面水平。

sentences.c: The whole place is at sea level.
sentences.cn: 整个地区与海平面持平。

sentences.c: The sea level is going up because of climate change.
sentences.cn: 由于气候变化，海平面正在上升。

sentences.c: The floating cities could move up with the sea level.
sentences.cn: 漂浮的城市会随着海平面上升。

trans.cn: 水平面
水平仪：通过槽或U形管中的水面来显示水平的仪器。
水面：静止水体的表面。
水线：特定物体或柱状水体的表面所处的水平。

sentences.c: The water level of the Mississippi River is already 6.5 feet below normal.
sentences.cn: 密西西比河的水位已经比正常水位低6.5英尺。

sentences.c: The water clock told the time by the water level in the bowls.
sentences.cn: 水钟是根据碗中的水位来报时的。

sentences.c: There wasn't enough difference between the height of the ground level and the water level.
sentences.cn: 地面高度与水位没什么明显的区别。

trans.cn: 化学水平
化学水平：指化学反应中的分子、原子或离子的数量或浓度。

sentences.c: The more worrying changes are happening on a chemical level.
sentences.cn: 更令人担忧的变化发生在化学层面。

sentences.c: There are tens of thousands of proteins in the body that build and control life at the chemical level.
sentences.cn: 在我们的身体里存在着上万种蛋白质，它们以化学方式建立和支配生命。

sentences.c: Complete product high - medium - low, food grade, chemical level. Have food grade QS (inspection certificate), welcome customers to negotiate the choose and buy.
sentences.cn: 产品高-中-低档齐全，食品级，化工级。已取得食品级QS(商检证)，欢迎广大客户洽谈选购。

trans.cn: 中间阶段
中间阶段：指在某个过程或发展中处于中间位置或阶段的阶段。

sentences.c: In general, the industrialization in western Regions is now striding forward to an intermediate stage.
sentences.cn: 西部地区的工业化总体上进入到了由初级向中级迈进的阶段。

sentences.c: The charge is conserved not only from "before" to " after " but also at every intermediate stage of the process.
sentences.cn: 电荷不仅由衰变“前”到衰变“后”是守恒的，而且在衰变过程的每一个中间的阶段也都是守恒的。

sentences.c: According to require of temperature and humidity of the intermediate stage genebank, introduced a kind of hot Freon defrosting system.
sentences.cn: 根据中期种质库的温湿度要求，介绍了一种热氟冲霜系统。

synos.cn: 中间阶段；[计]中间级；中间期

trans.cn: 压力程度
压力水平：指个体或群体所面临的压力的程度或强度。

sentences.c: Stress levels increased 18% for women and 24% for men from 1983 to 2009.
sentences.cn: 从1983年到2009年，女性和男性的压力水平分别上升了18%和24%。

sentences.c: Her sole duty, as far as I could tell, was to raise global stress levels.
sentences.cn: 据我所知，她唯一的职责就是提高全球的压力水平。

sentences.c: The American Psychological Association reports a gender gap year after year showing that women consistently report higher stress levels.
sentences.cn: 美国心理学会年复一年地报告性别差距，表明女性持续报告更高的压力水平。

trans.cn: 可能的压力来源

sentences.c: What are the possible causes of stress and obesity Zoo-raised elephants generally suffer from?
sentences.cn: 动物园中饲养的大象遭受压力和肥胖的可能的原因是______________。

sentences.c: Possible causes for the setbacks include stress the children experience as result of seeing their parents blaming each other for the divorce or arguing about custody.
sentences.cn: 这些孩子看到自己的父母闹离婚，争夺抚养权，他们内心会承受巨大的压力，因而学习成绩下滑厉害。

sentences.c: The reasonable mining design should avoid and relieve the stress as far as possible the high degree of concentration and has because the stress to elevate the danger which causes.
sentences.cn: 合理的开采设计应尽量避免和解除应力的高度集中和发生因应力升高而引起的危险。

trans.cn: 合理管理时间

sentences.c: They didn't work anywhere and all the time—they were better able to manage their work.
sentences.cn: 他们不是在某地一直工作——他们能更好地管理自己的工作。

sentences.c: You'd better manage your time better and have things organized.
sentences.cn: 你最好把时间安排得更好，把事情安排好。

sentences.c: She told me that she understood me but that I needed to learn how to manage my time better.
sentences.cn: 她告诉我，她理解我，但我需要学习如何更好地管理我的时间。

trans.cn: 担心失业
失业恐慌：指对失业的担忧和恐惧，担心自己会失去工作而无法维持生计。

sentences.c: According to a study published in Social Science and Medicine, fear of unemployment is much worse than actual unemployment in terms of long-term health problems.
sentences.cn: 根据在《社会科学与医药》中发布的一项研究表明，害怕失业要比因长期的健康问题造成的实际失业糟糕的多。

sentences.c: Besides the resulting unemployment, some researchers fear this would waste an opportunity to use the new data to reveal the true workings of the sources and sinks of gases.
sentences.cn: 除了所导致的失业问题，一些研究者还担心这样会丧失一个利用新数据揭示资源实际价值以及温室气体增减变化的契机。

sentences.c: Some economists fear that unemployment, now a touch over 6%, might reach 10%; in 1933 it was about 25%, and many of those in work were on short time and short pay.
sentences.cn: 部分经济学家担心现已超过6%的失业率将达到10%。而1933该数值为25%，而即使有工作的，很大一部分也是打短工，收部分酬劳的。

trans.cn: 失业率
失业率：一个国家或地区没有工作的人数或百分比。

sentences.c: The unemployment rate has been projected to fall.
sentences.cn: 据预测失业率将下降。

sentences.c: The state's unemployment rate rose slightly to 7.1 percent last month.
sentences.cn: 该国的失业率上个月略微上升到7.1%。

sentences.c: I don't think the unemployment rate ever tells us much about the future.
sentences.cn: 我认为失业率不会告诉我们很多关于未来的东西。

trans.cn: 周边环境
物理环境：指一个人或物所处的周围环境，包括地理位置、气候、建筑物、自然景观等。

sentences.c: People also react in surprising ways to their physical surroundings.
sentences.cn: 人们对周遭物理环境的反应也不尽相同。

sentences.c: Make sure that the people around you and your physical surroundings support your goals.
sentences.cn: 确保你周围的人与你的周围现实支持你的目标。

sentences.c: However, there is another significant aspect of environment as the physical surroundings where most species originated and evolved.
sentences.cn: 不过，就大多数物种在其中得以产生及演化的天然外界环境而言，它还有另一个值得注意的方面。

trans.cn: 工作负荷大
工作太多：指某项活动需要付出大量努力，因此你不想去做。

sentences.c: It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work.
sentences.cn: 普遍认为，紧张是工作过重所致。

sentences.c: He felt his boss was piling too much work on him.
sentences.cn: 他觉得上司派给他的工作太多。

sentences.c: Nelson seldom exercises because he has too much work every day.
sentences.cn: 尼尔森很少锻炼，因为他每天工作太多。

trans.cn: 缓解压力
应对压力：采取措施来应对生活、工作或其他方面的压力。

sentences.c: Natural, spontaneous humor is one of your greatest tools for coping with stress as you work.

主题访问：主题访问是指在给定的文献数据库（例如图书馆分类系统）中访问图书、期刊和其他文档的方法和系统。文献文件中的单个记录按字段结构化，每个字段都可以进行搜索并与其他字段组合。记录字段中的可搜索数据称为访问点。其中一些访问点包含诸如作者姓名、页数、出版语言、出版商名称等信息。这些在图书馆行话中称为“描述性数据”。其他类型的访问点包含标题词、分类代码、索引术语等信息。它们被称为主题访问点。

sentences.cn: 合格的学校将得到长期的贷款和初步的基础。

sentences.c: Once Ronald Lauder became owner of the painting, it went to the Neue Galerie on long-term loan.
sentences.cn: 当莱纳德•劳德成了这幅画的主人之后，这幅作品长期地被借给了新画廊。

trans.cn: 筹资
企业贷款：向公司提供的贷款，而不是向政府机构或个人提供的贷款。

sentences.c: There is already evidence that corporate-loan demands have diminished sharply and that commercial Banks have hesitated to lend while choosing to firewall risks.
sentences.cn: 已经有迹象表明企业贷款需求下降很快，而商业银行则在犹豫应该贷款出去还是选择规避风险。

sentences.c: Institutional investors are keen again on bank loan participations, covenant-light corporate debt, exotic asset-backed securities, and all manner of commercial real estate.
sentences.cn: 机构投资者再度热衷于银行参与贷款、盟约亮点公司债券、具有国外背景的资产担保证券(asset - backed security)以及各种形式的商业房地产。

trans.cn: 固定花费
固定费用：在经营过程中不会随着销售量或生产量的变化而发生变化的费用，如租金、工资、保险费等。

sentences.c: If, thereafter, their subcontracts are for some reason reduced, such firms can face potentially crippling fixed expenses.
sentences.cn: 如果此后，他们的分包合同由于某种原因被削减，这些公司可能会面临潜在的严重的固定支出。

sentences.c: Look for expenses that can be cut back, and don't give up in the face of high fixed expenses.
sentences.cn: 找一些可以削减的花销，在高昂的固定花销方面不要放弃。

sentences.c: This lets companies reduce fixed expenses while rewarding you for meeting company expectations.
sentences.cn: 这让公司减少了固定支出，而如果你的业绩符合公司的期望，就能够得到额外的奖励。

trans.cn: 选择性支出

sentences.c: The above expense is excluded the personal Homa, optional visiting trip, Internet, gift shop, books, CDS and other random expenses.
sentences.cn: 以上费用不包含个人火供、可选拜访、上网、礼物店、书籍、碟片等其他自费项目。

trans.cn: 生活费
生活费用：指一个人或家庭在日常生活中所需的开支，包括食物、住房、交通、医疗等方面的费用。

sentences.c: When father lost his job, our living expenses had to be cut to the bone.
sentences.cn: 父亲失业后， 我们不得不把生活费用减低到最低限度。

sentences.c: Tokyo and Singapore are both attractive, but the living expenses there are incredibly high.
sentences.cn: 东京和新加坡都很有吸引力，但是那里的生活费用高得令人难以置信。

sentences.c: That includes twelve months of living expenses estimated at twenty thousand dollars.
sentences.cn: 这包括12个月的生活费，估计为2万美元。

trans.cn: 金融问题

sentences.c: There remains the problem of finance.
sentences.cn: 财政问题仍然存在。

sentences.c: Security control is a key technique problem of finance computerizing information system.
sentences.cn: 安全性控制是金融电子化信息系统的技术关键。

sentences.c: And an ongoing international process for resolving the problem of global finance is critical.
sentences.cn: 关键是要有一个正在开展的解决全球金融问题的国际化进程。

trans.cn: 花销计划
支出计划：指个人、家庭或组织为了达成特定目标而制定的支出计划，通常包括预算、开支和储蓄等方面的规划。

sentences.c: The Labor party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power.
sentences.cn: 工党最近宣布，如果它重新掌权，将保留联合政府的大部分开支计划。

sentences.c: Capital spending plans are being scaled back for the third quarter in a row.
sentences.cn: 各大公司正连续第三季度削减其资本支出计划。

sentences.c: The country's massive debt could hobble the party's social-spending plans.
sentences.cn: 日本的庞大债务有可能阻碍该党实施其社会支出计划。

trans.cn: 缺钱
资金短缺：指缺乏足够的资金或金钱。

sentences.c: Shortage of money led to the failure of the experiments.
sentences.cn: 资金缺乏导致实验的失败。

sentences.c: As long as the market is allowed to clear, no shortage of money can emerge.
sentences.cn: 只要保持市场是透明的，就不会出现货币短缺。

sentences.c: The WHO chief warned that a shortage of money could also limit other progress.
sentences.cn: 她警告说，资金短缺还可能限制其他方面的进展。

trans.cn: 缺钱

sentences.c: The initial aim to introduce the FDI is to make up financial shortage, create employment and gain advanced technology.
sentences.cn: 我国最初引进外资是为了弥补资金缺口、创造就业，同时获得国外先进的技术。

sentences.c: The article mainly studies on the recent financial system, financial management and taxation in the light of country's financial shortage of our province and try to find the reason.
sentences.cn: 本文针对我省目前乡级财力匮乏的现状，主要从我国目前的财政体制、财政管理的机制以及税收等方面努力探讨其成因。

sentences.c: The financial crisis did not end the asset shortage, say the theory's proponents.
sentences.cn: 这个理论的支持者说，金融危机没有终结安全资产短缺。

trans.cn: 食物缺乏
食物短缺：指某地区或某个时期内食物供应不足的情况，导致人们无法获得足够的食物。

sentences.c: Vietnam is suffering from food shortage.
sentences.cn: 越南正遭受食品短缺之苦。

sentences.c: In 1960, a very serious food shortage happened in China.
sentences.cn: 1960年，中国遇到了严重的粮食短缺问题。

sentences.c: His research greatly solved the problem of the food shortage in the world.
sentences.cn: 他的研究极大地解决了世界粮食短缺的问题。

trans.cn: 财务问题
财务事务：管理个人或组织的财务活动，或与此相关的情况。

sentences.c: His financial affairs are in a tangle.
sentences.cn: 他的财务一塌糊涂。

sentences.c: I looked after my father's financial affairs.
sentences.cn: 我照管父亲的财务。

sentences.c: His financial affairs were in complete disorder.
sentences.cn: 他的财务完全是一笔糊涂账。

trans.cn: 财政预算
财政预算：指政府或企业在一定时期内，根据其财务状况和经济发展情况，对收支情况进行预测和规划的文件或计划。

sentences.c: The financial budget concerns everyone in the city.
sentences.cn: 财政预算关乎城中每一个人。

sentences.c: My uncle handles the financial budget of the company.
sentences.cn: 我叔叔管理公司的财政预算。

sentences.c: Position description: financial budget and final accounts management.
sentences.cn: 职位描述：财务预算、核算、决算管理。

trans.cn: 理财建议
财务建议：为客户提供有关财务方面的建议和指导，以帮助他们做出更好的财务决策。

sentences.c: Many middle-class occupations—trucking, financial advice, software engineering—have aroused their interest, or soon will.
sentences.cn: 许多中产阶级的职业，如卡车运输、金融咨询、软件工程已经引起了他们的兴趣，或者很快就会引起他们的兴趣。

sentences.c: But many middle-class occupations—trucking, financial advice, software engineering—have aroused their interest, or soon will.
sentences.cn: 但是许多中产阶级的职业，包括卡车运输、金融咨询、软件工程等，已经或者很快会引起他们的兴趣。

sentences.c: You should refuse to meet anyone who cold-calls you with an offer of financial advice.
sentences.cn: 你应该拒绝见任何通过陌生推销拜访来提供理财咨询的人。

trans.cn: 财务主管
财务高管：指在公司或组织中负责财务管理和决策的高级职位，负责监督财务活动、制定财务策略和报告财务状况。

sentences.c: This thesis discussed the improvement of financial awareness of financial executive.
sentences.cn: 本文就对财务主管理财意识的提高进行了讨论。

sentences.c: Maybe a financial executive wants to look at the projects that have the most impact from a financial perspective.
sentences.cn: 而财务主管却会以财务的角度，去分析它会对公司的财务核算带来多大的影响。

sentences.c: In a conversation with an it executive, a financial executive said that he wanted to implement and automate certain types of financial management practices.
sentences.cn: 在与一个IT主管的交谈中，财务主管说他想要实现并自动化某些类型的财务管理实践。

trans.cn: 金融系
财务部门：一个组织或公司中负责财务管理和会计工作的部门。

sentences.c: The financial department handles all of our banking.
sentences.cn: 财务部门负责我们所有的银行业务。

sentences.c: I think I can do better if I get the transfer to the financial department.
sentences.cn: 如果能调到财务部门，我认为我可以做得更好。

sentences.c: Financial department on the product price compare analysis, evaluation.
sentences.cn: 财务部对供方产品的价格进行比价分析、评价。

trans.cn: 金融政策
财政政策：指国家或组织制定和实施的关于财政收入和支出的方针、措施和规定。

sentences.c: The CFO is deeply involved in financial policy and corporate planning.
sentences.cn: CFO的工作是深度参与公司财务政策的指定和企业规划。

sentences.c: The crisis has increased calls for greater cooperation on European financial policy.
sentences.cn: 这场金融危机要求欧洲金融政策更加协调合作。

sentences.cn: 这项声明的本意是为了消除疑虑，然而，它更像是强调美联储是多么深陷于财政与金融政策的泥潭之中。

trans.cn: 财务问题
财务问题：指个人或组织在财务方面遇到的困难或挑战，如缺乏资金、债务过多等。

sentences.c: Your financial problems do not interest me.
sentences.cn: 我对你的财务问题不感兴趣。

sentences.c: Financial problems are plaguing the company.
sentences.cn: 财政问题使这家公司焦头烂额。

sentences.c: Rumours began to circulate about his financial problems.
sentences.cn: 有关他财务困难的谣言开始流传开来。

trans.cn: 经济目标
财务目标：在个人理财中设定的目标，如建立合理的个人财务规划、参与投资活动等。

sentences.c: He suggested that preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals.
sentences.cn: 他建议，尚未退休的人员应该咨询财务顾问，制定长期的财务目标。

sentences.c: Create and regularly review financial goals.
sentences.cn: 建立并规律性地温故自己的财政目标。

sentences.c: The next step is starting to set some financial goals.
sentences.cn: 下一步则是开始设定一些财政目标。

trans.cn: 金融市场
金融市场：一个市场，人们在这里买卖金融证券（如股票和债券）和商品。

sentences.c: And it was a real financial market.
sentences.cn: 它是一个真正的金融市场。

sentences.c: Cloud-enabled financial market data solution: For a hybrid cloud.
sentences.cn: 应用云计算的金融市场数据解决方案：用于混合云。

sentences.c: Figure 2 also shows a precedent for recent financial market strains.
sentences.cn: 最近的金融市场紧张，在图2中可以看到一个前例。

trans.cn: 金融存款
财务储蓄：指个人或企业在日常生活或经营活动中所进行的节约和储蓄行为，以达到财务稳健和未来投资的目的。

sentences.c: Borrowers are striving to ease their financial position by spending less and saving more.
sentences.cn: 借款者都在努力通过少花多存来缓解经济紧张状况。

sentences.c: As the children become financially independent of the family, the emphasis on family financial security will shift from protection to saving for the retirement years.
sentences.cn: 随着孩子们在家庭中变得经济独立，家庭经济保障的重点将从保护转移到为退休储蓄。

sentences.c: The reason for saving a big financial institution that gets into trouble is the economic havoc its failure can cause.
sentences.cn: 挽救主要金融机构，使其远离麻烦的原因是为了避免其崩溃所引致的大破坏。

sentences.cn: 我可以要你的名片吗？

sentences.cn: 对不起，把你的名片丢了。

sentences.cn: 我打开一个有拉链的口袋看到一张卡片写着一些英文：“美国经典。”

sentences.c: Sir, here is my business card.

sentences.cn: 这是折扣价吗？

sentences.c: It's a discount price.
sentences.cn: 这已经是打过折扣的价格了。

sentences.c: Are not you selling this at a discount price?
sentences.cn: 你们不是有折扣的吗？

sentences.c: Many agents sell life, health, and property insurance as well as products such annuities.

sentences.c: Scientists made their forecast after combining data from aerial photographs and ground measurements of ice thickness.

sentences.c: Aerial photographs add another problem due to the distortion of the image as the point moves form the centre of the photograph.

sentences.c: Herbst also offers marketing support, including a page on his website, though his clients arrange for their own aerial photographs of the mazes.
sentences.cn: Herbst还提供销售支持，将顾客自己通过航空拍摄的农田迷宫照片放在他的公司网站上。

trans.cn: 沙漠中的盆地

sentences.c: The delta forms where the river empties into a basin in the Kalahari Desert, creating a maze of lagoons, channels and islands where vegetation flourishes, even in the dry season, and wildlife abounds.
sentences.cn: 河流从这个三角洲流入卡拉·哈里沙漠的一个盆地，形成纵横交错的咸水湖、河道及岛屿，在那里，野生动植物比比皆是，即使在极为干燥的季节，草木依然丰茂。

sentences.c: Qaidam basin, located in the provincial Northwest, most of the Gobi Desert and over the eastern marshes, Salt Lake, the terrain is typical of the highest plateau inland basins.
sentences.cn: 柴达木盆地位于创省西北部，大部分为戈壁、沙漠，东部多沼泽、盐湖，是我国地势最高的典型的内陆高原盆。

sentences.c: The principal composition analysis (PCA) was used to study the multivariate characteristics of desert vegetation in Junnger Basin.
sentences.cn: 用主成分分析排序法分析准噶尔盆地沙漠植被的多元特征。

sentences.c: Now I view chores as a family relationship builder instead of a burden.
sentences.cn: 现在我把家务更多的看做是一种建立家庭关系的方式而非重担了。

sentences.cn: 在大门口，他们付了五美元的门票钱。

sentences.cn: 我的家庭大多将它们仅作为“接入点”。

sentences.c: The World Health Organization says there has been a sharp increase in the number of children in developing countries who weigh too much.

sentences.c: Most of them have young children below school age.

sentences.c: One famous experiment in the 1960s involved 3- to 6-year-old children.

trans.cn: 烟雾警报
烟雾报警器的复数形式：用于检测烟雾并发出警报的设备，通常用于家庭、办公室或其他建筑物中，以提醒人们有烟雾或火灾的存在。

sentences.c: The rooms were all fitted with smoke alarms.
sentences.cn: 所有的房间都安装了烟雾报警器。

sentences.cn: 我们在所有楼梯上都装有运转完全正常的烟雾报警器。

trans.cn: 火警
火警报警器：一种设备，当发生火灾时会发出响亮的声音来警示人们。

sentences.c: Who set off the fire alarm?
sentences.cn: 谁拉响了火警报警器？

sentences.c: The smoke sets off the fire alarm.
sentences.cn: 烟雾触发了火警报警器。

sentences.cn: 那次讲座被突然鸣响的火警中断了。

trans.cn: 警报系统
防盗警报系统：一种用于防止入侵的警报系统。

trans.cn: 闹钟
闹钟：一种可以设定在特定时间响铃的钟表。

sentences.c: I set my alarm clock for 4:30.
sentences.cn: 我把闹钟定在4:30。

sentences.c: I set the alarm clock for 7 o'clock.
sentences.cn: 我把闹钟定在7点钟闹响。

sentences.cn: 他把闹钟塞在枕头底下，想减低声音。

trans.cn: 私立学校
私立学校：由非政府机构建立、管理和主要支持的学校。

sentences.c: My parents sent me to a fancy private school.
sentences.cn: 我父母把我送到了一所阔气的私立学校。

sentences.cn: 华盛顿的一所小型私立学校已经在这样做了。

私人旅行：指由个人或小团体自行安排的旅行，通常不包括旅行社的服务和安排。

sentences.c: The White House called his trip a “solely private mission”.
sentences.cn: 白宫方面将其此行描述为“单独的私人行动”。

sentences.c: I politely declined Richard's invitation for a trip a sunny resort somewhere down south, and happily escaped to the bathroom, because getting dressed is a private activity.
sentences.cn: 我客气的婉拒了Richard提出的南下到一个阳光明媚旅游胜地的旅行邀请，高兴地溜进洗手间，还好，穿衣服算是私人活动。

sentences.c: The recollection of the trip is entirely personal and private.
sentences.cn: 对旅程的回忆完全是个人的和隐私的。

trans.cn: 电动汽车 ( 吞 )

sentences.cn: 混合动力汽车，不像纯电动汽车，从不需要接电源。

sentences.c: Fans of electric cars say they are clean, quiet, and economical.
sentences.cn: 电动车爱好者说电动车无污染，无噪音，而且经济。

sentences.c: Electric cars themselves are more expensive.
sentences.cn: 电动汽车本身更加昂贵。

sentences.c: The State encourages and supports the generation of electricity through the use of renewable and clean energy resources.

trans.cn: 防火门
防火门：一种防火门，特指一种由熔断链或热控装置保持在开启位置的自动门，设计用于在受热影响下释放门并通过重力、重物或其他装置关闭。

sentences.c: What happens to the centralized electric grid, which took decades and billions of dollars to build, as more and more people become "prosumers", who produce and consume their own energy onsite?

sentences.cn: 不幸的是，他们是公司最不能失去的人，即那些拥有最高级的技能和经验的人。

sentences.c: I firmly hold the view that living in another country for education purpose is advantageous for students who want to increase their language skills and experience different cultures.

sentences.c: Join us as a Team Member, Assistant Manager or Cafe Manager, depending on your skills and experience.
sentences.cn: 根据您的技能和经验，加入我们，成为团队成员、副经理或咖啡馆经理。

sentences.cn: 他重新开始抨击政府的欧洲政策。

sentences.c: These latest developments argue a change in government policy.

sentences.c: We badly need to get a result from this match.

sentences.cn: 谈到她的经历，谭说：“参加 WLA 论坛，与伟大的科学家面对面地交流，进一步鼓励了我做数学之类的科学研究。我梦想着取得和顶尖科学家一样优秀的研究成果。”

sentences.c: With research results showing the cumulative effects of sleep loss and its impact on productivity, doubt has been voiced about the accuracy of Steel's self-assessment.

sentences.cn: 广告直邮业已经很会为特价销售做包装宣传了。
